fullContentHtml:
The TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025 for the August Government Technical Examination (GTE) session has been officially declared. The GTE Typewriting exams were conducted on 30 and 31 August 2025 for various grades, including Pre-Junior, Junior, Senior, and High Speed. Conducted by the Tamil Nadu Directorate of Technical Education (TNDTE) this exam evaluates candidates’ proficiency in English and Tamil Typewriting at both Junior and Senior grades . Aspirants who appeared for the exam can now check their results online via the official portal .

This article provides the latest status, direct result link, a step-by-step guide to download the marksheet, and details on the information displayed on the scorecard. The instructions are simplified for easy navigation and quick result access.

TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025: Status 

The TNDTE Typewriting GTE Result 2025 for the August session has been released online by the Directorate of Technical Education, Tamil Nadu. Candidates from both private and government institutes can now access their scorecards through the official website.

The exam covered several categories — English and Tamil (Junior & Senior Grades) — under the Government Technical Examination (GTE). The evaluation process is completed, and digital marksheets are now live on the portal.

 Result Status: Declared for August 2025 Exam
 Exam Conducting Body: Tamil Nadu Directorate of Technical Education (TNDTE)

TNDTE GTE Result 2025 Download Link

The Directorate provides an easy access link to view and download the TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025 directly . The portal works smoothly on updated browsers like Chrome and Edge .

Direct Link to Check TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025

Once logged in, click the ‘Download Result’ or ‘Print Result’ button. Save the PDF file on your device or cloud drive to ensure permanent access .

How To Download TNDTE Typewriting Results 2025?

Candidates can easily view and download their TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025 by following these verified steps. Make sure to use the correct registration number and date of birth as mentioned on your hall ticket to avoid login errors.

Step-by-step process:

  • Visit the official TNDTE GTE result portal — https://tndtegteonline.in/.
  • Click on “GTE Typewriting August 2025 Result” on the homepage.
    1. Select your Exam Category (English/Tamil) and Grade (Junior/Senior).
    2. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth in the required format.
    3. Click on ‘View Result’ to display your scorecard on screen
  • Download or print your TNDTE Typewriting marksheet for future reference.

Tip: If the page takes time to load, try again during non-peak hours. Avoid entering spaces or extra characters in your registration number.

Mandatory Login Credentials (Registration Number and Date of Birth)

To access your TNDTE GTE Typewriting Result, you must log in using two key credentials — your Registration Number and Date of Birth (DOB). Enter them exactly as recorded in your application form.

Login Format Table

Field Description Correct Format Common Mistake
Registration Number Found on your admit card or hall ticket Use uppercase letters, no spaces Using lowercase or adding spaces
Date of Birth As per registration data DD/MM/YYYY Using wrong separators like “-“
Captcha (if applicable) Security check on screen Enter exact characters Skipping or misreading letters

If your credentials do not match, double-check your admit card or contact your training institute for confirmation.

Details Mentioned on the TNDTE Marksheet / Scorecard

The TNDTE Typewriting marksheet 2025 contains both candidate and performance details. Review it thoroughly to ensure that all entries are correct before downloading or printing. Any discrepancies should be reported to your institution immediately.

Key details printed on the marksheet:

Category Details Shown
Candidate Information Name, Registration Number, Date of Birth
Examination Details Session (August 2025), Language (English/Tamil), Grade (Junior/Senior)
Centre Details Exam Centre Name and Code
Marks & Grade Paper-wise Marks, Pass/Fail Status
Result Verification Result Date, QR Code, Verification Line

TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025 FAQs

Q1. When was the TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025 released?

Ans: The TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025 for the August session has been declared on the official portal — https://tndtegteonline.in. Candidates can download their marksheets online.

Q2. How can I check my TNDTE Typewriting Result 2025 online?

Ans: Visit the official website, click on “GTE Typewriting August 2025 Result”, enter your registration number and date of birth and click “View Result” to access your marksheet .

Q3. What details are required to download the TNDTE Typewriting marksheet?

Ans: You need your Registration Number and Date of Birth exactly as printed on your hall ticket . Enter the credentials carefully to avoid login errors .

Q4. What details are mentioned on the TNDTE Typewriting scorecard?

Ans: The marksheet includes the candidate’s name, registration number, grade, exam centre, marks/grade, and pass/fail status. Verify all details before saving or printing it.
